prefix.description: SEL-735 Power Quality and Revenue Meter

part_number.note: 25-character MOT string. Fully triangulated against a real PARTNO from the SEL-735 Instruction Manual and the QuickSet Model Option Table (Figure 2.17), whose template is *735H*0*94*BX*X***161****. Drawing layers anchor positions 6 (enclosure), 9 (meter form), 12 (Slot B comms/Ethernet), 13 (Slot C), 15 (Slot D), and 22 (front-panel labeling). Position 5 is the chassis/display type (H and L confirmed; other letters map to distinct panel drawings). Positions 8, 14, 17, 18, and 25 are wildcard/reserved digits in the QuickSet MOT and are constant in observed part numbers. WI-16251 covers the color-touchscreen (L) chassis; other chassis letters share the same digit layout.
references: SEL-735 Power Quality and Revenue Meter With Color Touchscreen - Ordering Information (WI-16251, 20251015)
SEL-735 Instruction Manual (735_IM_20250711), Figure 2.17 SEL-735 Model Option Table
SEL-735 master configuration drawings i7299/i7300/i7386/i7387/i7388/i7389/i7390 (drawing layers)

example_part_numbers.note: Real PARTNO from the SEL-735 Instruction Manual (735_IM_20250711): color touchscreen chassis, no enclosure, Advanced PQ and Recording, Form 9, 110-240 Vac/110-250 Vdc supply with 125 V control inputs, single 10/100BASE-T EIA-485 Ethernet, empty Slots C and D, Slot Z CL2/10/20 (low-end accuracy), 60 Hz, Standard plus IEC 61850, ANSI labeling, no conformal coat, no software bundle.
